summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed under Rule 424(b)(5) to update the sales agents for an existing at-the-market offering of up to $25 million of 6.375% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock. No shares have been sold yet; the issuer has merely added Cantor Fitzgerald and Huntington Securities as additional sales agents and amended existing distribution agreements. This is a routine capital markets filing, not a special situation. No tender, acquisition, activist, or restructuring event is involved. The filing simply expands the distribution channel for a pre-registered preferred stock offering.
